name: CDX Media Uploader
description: General-purpose file upload and media hosting API — serves images, audio, and video via HTTP with presigned URLs, auth tokens, and size limits. Built for FiveM (lb-phone, qb-phone, HUDs, inventories) but works with any project that needs a lightweight self-hosted file endpoint.
author: Codexis

scripts.installation: apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl && curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" && export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH" && if [ -f package.json ]; then bun install --production && bun run build; fi

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Public URL for file access (e.g. http://your-ip:3000). Must be reachable by game clients.

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: Shared secret for auth (set same value in your client config)

variables.name: Max Size (MB)
variables.description: Maximum upload file size in megabytes
